claim: Check what a snapshot really is before planning: a BASIC-loader dump may have a twin that is the game running, and a captured interrupt PC or retained BASIC is not loader evidence.

evidence.text: The (128K) dump is a BASIC loader that would page ROM 0; its [a][a] twin is the same game already running.
evidence.quote: The (128K) dump is a BASIC loader that would page ROM 0; its [a][a] twin is the same game already running.

evidence.text: PC 0x0051 with SP FFDA is a captured ROM interrupt, not a BASIC loader.
evidence.quote: PC0051/SPFFDA is a captured ROM interrupt, not a BASIC loader

evidence.text: The snapshot is the tape's BASIC start; it holds the code 0x6AC higher and the game moves itself down at 0xE436, so sites are addressed in play.
evidence.quote: the snapshot holds them 0x6AC higher, the game moves itself down at 0xE436

evidence.text: The generic ROM-path check rejected a full code overlay that collided with the calculator; test the actual archive startup, not only in-game fixtures.
evidence.quote: Keep the original ROM and tiny audited map-to-RAM veneers; test the actual archive startup, not only in-game fixtures.
